edge_sample.target_text: proof : If there is such a test then by \Cref{Hippo_compute} there is a test $\{U_n\}_{n\in\omega}$ as in the hypothesis of \Cref{not_compute_test}, whence $p$ is computable.

edge_sample.source_text: theorem : For all $p$, if there is a Hippocratic $\mu_p$-test $\{U_n\}_{n\in\omega}$ such that $\{X:X\not\ge_T p\}\subseteq\cap_n U_n$, then $p$ is computable.
edge_sample.target_text: corollary : There is no universal Hippocratic $\mu_p$-test, unless $p$ is computable.
